description: Angular component for configuring widget font settings, including form controls for font family, size, style, weight, color, and optional shadow color.

classes.name: WidgetFontComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing font settings in a widget, implementing ControlValueAccessor for form integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group with font properties and optional shadow color, sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form value.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method stub for registering touch callback, not implemented.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input boolean.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form values based on the provided WidgetFont object.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates the change when form values change.
